item.stem:
Anvi draws rectangle $ABCD$ with diagonal $AC$, as in the diagram. Triangle $ABC$ uses three corners of the rectangle.

Which claim about the areas is correct?

options.A: Triangle $ABC$ has half the area of rectangle $ABCD$.
options.B: The area of triangle $ABC$ equals the length of diagonal $AC$.
options.C: Rectangle $ABCD$ has half the area of triangle $ABC$.
options.D: Triangle $ABC$ and rectangle $ABCD$ have the same area.
